title: Smart Analytics & Reporting
description: An analytics engine that turns operational data into targeted insights that drive action, not just observation. Built for complex facilities, it empowers your team with clear operational visibility, faster response times, and continuous improvement

bullets.title: Auto-generated insights, powered by AWS QuickSight
bullets.description: Automatically surface trends and anomalies across all building systems — no manual report-building required.

bullets.title: 360° visibility into performance metrics
bullets.description: Track energy use, equipment health, and occupancy patterns across every floor and system in real time.

bullets.title: Built-in actionable intelligence
bullets.description: Every insight comes paired with a recommended next step, so your team knows exactly what to do and when.

title: Smart Alerts
description: Alerts that offer more than just a warning—delivering precise, actionable intelligence when it matters most. From early fault detection to guided resolution, your team has everything they need to stay ahead of failures and downtime.

bullets.title: Automated Fault Detection and Diagnostics
bullets.description: Identify equipment faults before they become failures using pattern recognition across live sensor data.

bullets.title: Role-based alerts
bullets.description: Route the right alert to the right person — engineers, managers, and technicians each see only what's relevant to them.

bullets.title: Personalized, multichannel communication
bullets.description: Receive alerts via SMS, email, or in-app notification, configured per user and severity level.

title: Facility-Wide Monitoring & Control
description: DeJoule acts as your building's central command—integrating data, control, and actions across all systems to ensure your facility runs in perfect sync.

bullets.title: Centralized system intelligence
bullets.description: Consolidate HVAC, lighting, access control, and more into a single operational view across your entire facility.

bullets.title: Unified smart control
bullets.description: Issue commands to any connected system from one interface — no switching between vendor dashboards.

bullets.title: Proactive maintenance workflows
bullets.description: Automatically trigger work orders and schedule maintenance based on real-time condition monitoring.

title: Intelligent Automation
description: Let's bring your systems to life with automation that evolves by the minute, making data-driven decisions to optimize performance without compromise

bullets.title: Joule Recipes for routine actions
bullets.description: Define multi-step automation sequences that trigger complex system actions from a single condition or schedule.

bullets.title: Dynamic equipment orchestration
bullets.description: Coordinate HVAC, lighting, and other equipment in real time based on occupancy, weather, and demand signals.

bullets.title: Balanced equipment utilization
bullets.description: Distribute runtime evenly across redundant equipment to maximize lifespan and minimize unexpected failures.
